verdict.rationale: Founder Law is an immigration and corporate law firm that sells attorney-led service packages. It is not a software agent or AI client that could connect to MCP servers and call their tools, so this MCP-client story does not fit the product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any agent or software client that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
